ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Waiting`. A drink costs 30 cents.

A 20c coin: `credit += 20`, then straight on through the connector `Check` in the same tick. `credit >= 30` is false, so the second, untriggered transition takes the machine back to `Waiting` (`credit` = 20).
A 10c coin: `credit` becomes 30, and `Check` sees the new value at once. The first transition fires: `credit -= 30` and `vend` is emitted, all in this tick.
`vend` is a signal, so it is present only in the tick it was emitted.

Both coins in one tick: `Waiting`'s transitions are tried in priority order, so the 20c one wins and the 10c coin is ignored: the machine keeps it, and the customer loses 10 cents. 20 + 20 = 40, so `Check` vends and leaves `credit` = 10.
